format: CHMT verification specification, not an executable OpenFOAM dictionary
precision: FP64 only; FP32 needs a separately frozen tolerance budget

cases.model: 1-D one-phase melting with resolved normal temperature; no flow, reactions, or film-averaged thermal approximation
cases.initial: Exact similarity state at positive absolute time t0=(0.1/(2 lambda))^2; elapsed simulation time begins at 0
cases.energy_zero: solid at T_melt has h=0; liquid at T_melt has h=1
cases.time_refinement: dt <= 0.1*dx^2; halve dt once more to isolate temporal error

cases.boundary: u(0)=ub; mu*du/dz(delta)=tau; material base velocity is distinct from arbitrary mesh velocity
cases.source: Direct integration of mu*u_zz=G with stated boundary conditions; derivation in criteria.md

cases.model: periodic conservative surface enthalpy advection with zero shear and zero pressure gradient
cases.boundary: periodic; all normal mass/heat flux, conduction, radiation, reaction and phase change disabled
cases.time_refinement: dt <= 0.1*dx^2; halve dt to demonstrate negligible time error relative to space error

cases.model: periodic conservative surface enthalpy transport plus explicit viscous dissipation
cases.boundary: periodic; no normal mass/heat flux, conduction, radiation, reactions or phase change; constant top traction
cases.time_refinement: dt <= 0.1*dx^2; halve dt to isolate spatial convergence
cases.source: Exact solution of H_t+u_mean*H_x=Phi, u_mean=tau*delta/(2*mu), Phi=delta*tau^2/mu

cases.model: constant-density fixed-volume pressure pulse, true thermodynamic enthalpy
cases.boundary: uniform p, no velocity/shear/temperature gradient or heat/mass transfer

cases.model: local moving-interface energy-jump contract only; not a time-evolved evaporation benchmark
cases.boundary: n points from liquid to gas; positive F_g leaves liquid; prescribe rho_l=J/(u_l,n-w_n) and rho_g=J/(u_g,n-w_n)

cases.model: periodic 2-D Euler free stream with passive fixed-composition species on moving quadrilateral mesh
cases.mesh: x=xi+a*sin(2*pi*xi)*sin(2*pi*t), y=eta+a*sin(2*pi*eta)*sin(2*pi*t); w is analytic time derivative; min directional Jacobian=1-2*pi*a>0
cases.boundary: periodic all sides; no viscosity, heat transfer, chemistry, particles or phase change
cases.time_refinement: dt=0.00025 (1000 full steps to final time); export every RK stage's geometry ledger
cases.source: Inspired by free-stream/ALE verification in https://www.math.hkust.edu.hk/~makxu/PAPER/ALE-GKS.pdf ; custom mesh defined here, not a reproduction of its tables

cases.model: periodic 2-D Euler entropy wave with u=v=1 and fixed pressure/composition
cases.mesh: same explicitly defined separable moving mesh as ale_free
cases.boundary: periodic all sides; no viscosity, heat transfer, chemistry, particles or phase change
cases.time_refinement: dt <= 0.05*dx^2 and halve dt to isolate space error

cases.model: one conservative 1-D piecewise-constant overlap rezone, no physical time advance
cases.initial: uniform: rho=1; step: rho=1 for donor i<3*n/8 else rho=2; conservative donor densities [rho,rho*u,p/(gamma-1)+rho*u^2/2,rho*Y1,rho*Y2]
cases.boundary: fixed endpoints, no boundary flux; first-order piecewise-constant remap only
cases.source: Exact interval intersections; custom mathematical conservation test

cases.required: Select and transcribe one complete manufactured solution, properties, moving surface and boundary flux from the paper; independently review signs and all coefficients; see external_data.md
cases.acceptance: No numeric baseline or passing threshold claimed until that complete input is frozen; observe declared space/time orders separately

cases.required: TACOT_1.5.xls, frozen initial pore-gas composition, tabulated independent reference results and provenance; see external_data.md
cases.acceptance: Blocked: no invented material table, successful result, or numerical tolerance

cases.required: TACOT_2.2.xls, B-prime/wall-enthalpy tables, complete boundary histories, independent reference results with uncertainty and frozen model category; see external_data.md
cases.acceptance: Blocked: preliminary PDF curves are not acceptance truth
